title: Holoblade
description: Adds a nice "holographic" texutre for diamond and nethrite swords
body:
An animated "holographic" texture for diamond and netherite swords achieved by making their textures 64x64, but keeping 16x16 style handle.

**[CIT version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/holoblade/version/cit1.0):**
- Rename sword to "Holoblade" to see custom texture
- Requires any CIT

**[Default version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/holoblade/version/def1.0):**
- Just changes the sword texture
